answer:
Soybean suits this field well, earning an overall suitability score of 92 out of 100 [S1]. It is judged reliable in 14 of 20 analysed years [S1]. 

The primary limiting factor is temperature in the growing window, where the worst month averages 19.2 °C against an optimal range of 20 to 33 °C [S1]. Other factors align very favorably with the crop's needs: total water over the growing window is 604 mm (comprising 414 mm of rain and 190 mm of stored soil water, meeting the optimal 600 to 1500 mm range), soil pH is 6.2 (within the 5.5 to 6.5 optimal range), and soil texture is medium [S1]. Sowing is modeled for month 6 [S1].
